message.content: {"diagnosis": "In REG_TYPE=2 skid buffer, when the first transfer is accepted and then s_axis_tvalid goes low for a few cycles while m_axis_tready stays low, the design incorrectly sets s_axis_tready=0 for those cycles, preventing a second push even though the temp register is still empty. The early-ready logic s_axis_tready_early = m_axis_tready || (!temp_valid && !m_axis_valid) allows ready only when m_axis_tready is asserted; it should also be asserted when temp register is empty and s_axis_tvalid is 0, so a new word can be captured into temp while output is stalled.", "edits": [{"file": "rtl/axis_register.v", "start_line": 129, "end_line": 129, "replacement": "    wire s_axis_tready_early = m_axis_tready || (!temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg && (!m_axis_tvalid_reg || !s_axis_tvalid));"}]}
